ارتقبوا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَقَبُوا (irtaqabū) /ir.ta.qa.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
# اُرْتُقِبُوا (urtuqibū) /ur.tu.qi.buː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
# اِرْتَقِبُوا (irtaqibū) /ir.ta.qi.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
